def nodup(pairs):

def read_path(p):

 try:
  after=os.fstat(fd); assert stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode) and (before.st_dev,before.st_ino)==(after.st_dev,after.st_ino); chunks=[]

  return b"".join(chunks)

def path(rel):

 p=os.path.join(ROOT,rel); assert os.path.commonpath([ROOT,os.path.realpath(p)])==ROOT; return p

 raw=base64.b64decode(match[0][2],validate=True); assert len(raw)==int(match[0][0]) and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==match[0][1]; compile(raw,name+".py","exec"); return raw
